candidate_relations.reason: Chordoma is a distinct notochordal malignancy of the clivus, not a trigeminal schwannoma; Meckel cave expansion through foramen ovale with CPA epicenter fits schwannoma rather than a clival primary.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Clival chordoma versus trigeminal nerve sheath tumor

candidate_relations.reason: Meningioma is a different extra-axial tumor; the multicystic nonrestricting mass expanding Meckel cave and foramen ovale is not meningeal in origin.
Hemangioblastoma is a cerebellar/cord vascular tumor, not a Meckel-cave CPA mass with foraminal extension along the trigeminal pathway.
